text:
Maya S: Quick heads-up — my PR (31122) bumped into a flaky CI failure on integration/kv-cache. Blocking merge. Can someone rerun or advise?
Jon P: Link? is this deterministic or noise?
Maya S: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/31122/checks — failing test is `TestKVCacheEviction::evict_race`. Happens on shard 7. Log snippet below:
```
--- FAIL: TestKVCacheEviction/evict_race (0.23s)
kv_cache_test.go:214: expected 0 entries, got 1
stack: kv/cache/evict.go:87
```
Sam T: I can queue a targeted rerun on shard 7 now. Historically this one flakes ~1/50. If rerun fails twice we should bisect.
Maya S: thanks — that would unblock the merge if green. Also need 1 more approval (jon, can you eyeball after rerun?).
Jon P: sure, I can give a quick approve if rerun is green. If it repros again I'll ask for a short bisect/skip.
Sam T: /rerun-ci --shard=7 --target=31122
buildkite-bot: queued rerun for PR 31122 (shard 7). Estimated ~4m.
ci-bot: rerun started on runner-gpu-12.
(build logs truncated)
buildkite-bot: rerun finished — status: flaky-pass (1/1) 
Maya S: looks green! anyone comfortable approving? I don't want to unstick the merge queue. :sweat_smile:
Jon P: gave quick-approve on PR. (left a note: "Approve to unblock; will follow up if this regresses") :thumbsup:
Rachel L: fyi, if this keeps happening we should add it to flaky-quarantine and create a follow-up to investigate race with eviction timer. I can file the ticket next sprint.
Maya S: sounds good — thanks everyone. Planning to merge during the next merge window (in ~10m) unless anyone objects.
Jon P: no objections, merge when ready.
buildkite-bot: merge check passed, merging to main.
Maya S: merged. Thanks all! :rocket:
